decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=REPLY, dst=/reply-ep, src=<path label 11:5>, kind=ERROR, STATUS{ ERROR{ VALUE u16=0x0020 } } } - the answer a terminus gives a label it cannot validate (RFC-0027 7.2): tr::path::not_found, nothing forwarded, nothing applied, nothing repaired.
decoded.note: The refused label is echoed back in the reply's src because the reply's src IS the request's dst - the terminus rewrites nothing on a refusal, and in particular does not mint. One answer covers every way validation can fail: out of range, generation mismatch, unminted slot, a label this host never minted, and a label whose peer identity was re-stamped by a re-added child. The sender's recovery is the full-string path it still holds.
